title: German Cabbage Stew
description: A hearty and comforting German-inspired stew made with tender cabbage and flavorful meat. Serve with a side of crusty bread or over mashed potatoes.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until it starts to soften, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle the caraway seeds and flour over the cabbage and stir to combine.
Add the beef broth and water, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the cabbage is tender, about 20 minutes.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, topped with additional melted butter if desired.
